summary: AT command layer on the USB CDC port: RT-Thread AT server on device cdc0 (port layer cdc_vcom.c) + src/at/at_cmds.c (AT+INFO, AT+LED, AT+BTN on the function layer).
readme: No SDK example uses the AT server; values from RT-Thread 5.0.2 components/net/at/Kconfig (AT server, end mark CR as in ITU-T V.250 - terminals send CR) and the cdc0 device of this recipe

files.what: port layer: TinyUSB CDC as RT-Thread device cdc0 (tud_cdc_rx_cb -> rx_indicate)
AT command layer: AT+INFO, AT+LED?, AT+LED=<n>,<0|1|2>, AT+BTN? on func/led and func/button
compiles src/at/ with the app layers (apps made before 2026-10-31 lack it)

inserts.what: the AT server finds its command table between __rtatcmdtab_start/_end; the FSP linker script has no such section

source_checks.what: RT-Thread's AT server (GCC) uses the linker symbols

notes: The test runs on the CDC COM port (pass it explicitly to serial_test.py), not on the console.
cdc_example (usb-cdc) is switched off: it would read the same CDC interface.
End mark CR: with CRLF the server echoes but never answers a terminal that sends CR only (seen on the board).
